subject: Nimbus - requested uptime remedy alternatives / exec approval
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SLA uplift trade & remedy flexibility for enterprise pilot

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Nimbus is excited about the integration. Before we finalize procurement, legal/procurement flagged the uptime target in your standard addendum (99.95%) as a non-starter for our public-facing product during pilot. We are proposing the following as a path to signature so we can move quickly: 

- Accept 99.50% uptime for the pilot (first 12 months)
- Service credit schedule: 5% credit for monthly uptime 98.0–99.4%, 15% for 96.0–97.9%, 30% below 96%
- A one-time commercial concession: 20% committed-use discount against year-one consumption

We understand this requires an exception. Procurement has a July 16 deadline for their board approval; if we can't get a sign-off from you by then we'll need to push to the next procurement window.

Attached is the SOW and a redline from our counsel (high level).

Appreciate a quick confirmation on whether this is something Redwood can accept or if you need alternative language.

Best,
Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Cloud Partnerships, Nimbus Cloud
[Attachment: NIM_SOW_v3.pdf (pdf)]

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@nimbuscloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA uplift trade & remedy flexibility for enterprise pilot

Sara — thanks for the clear ask and the SOW. 

Short answer: this is doable but needs an internal exception (uptime delta + credit schedule + discount). I'm looping in Monica (AM) and our COO, Vivek, to scope the commercial trade-offs. Can you confirm expected monthly spend (run-rate) and whether the pilot traffic will be routed through your EU region as well? Those affect our routing/backstop allowances.

We'll aim to come back with a proposed alternative that limits long-term exposure while getting you the runway you need to launch.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
redwood.inference | grace.oconnor@redwood.com

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 10:40:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Nimbus request — proposed exec-level response

Team — forwarding Nimbus' ask. Quick thinking on what we can offer to keep momentum without materially increasing risk: 

Proposal for exec approval: 
- Uptime: 99.5% for pilot (first 12 months only)
- Service credit: 5% credit 98.0–99.49%, 10% credit 96.0–97.99%, 20% credit <96% (credit applies to monthly recurring invoice, max one monthly invoice per month)
- Commercial: 18% committed-use discount applied to year-one consumption (concession in lieu of larger ongoing credits)
- Controls: Remedy is claim-based (customer must submit within 30 days) and credits capped at 20% of that month's invoice; Redwood liability remains subject to standard cap (1x annual fees)
- Term: require a 12-month minimum; prefer 24 months but can accept 12 for pilot with right to renegotiate

I need explicit approval from legal on the liability and credit caps and a commercial OK to offer 18% discount. Laura / Monica — please reply with approvals or redlines by EOD so I can respond before Nimbus' July 16 procurement deadline.

-Vivek
COO, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: proposed_amendment_nimbus.docx]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nimbus request — proposed exec-level response

Vivek — thanks. A few legal redlines and clarifications: 

1) Liability & caps: we can't expand our overall liability cap beyond standard (1x annual fees), but we should explicitly state that service credits are the exclusive remedy for uptime breaches to avoid double recovery attempts.
2) Credit mechanics: customers often expect automatic credits; we should keep it claim-based but include a short audit right to validate claims.
3) Credit cap: we can accept a monthly credit cap, but 20% is high for pilot. Recommend reducing cap to 15% of monthly invoice.
4) Term: to offset risk we should push for a 24-month commitment if we grant a reduced SLA. If Nimbus insists on 12 months, we should require a customer success QBR cadence and a dedicated reliability review at month 6.

I'll add these as tracked changes in the proposed amendment. If leadership prefers the commercial concession (18%) we need to ensure finance signs off on the expected LTV impact.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Executive approval requested — Nimbus exceptions summary (Approve / Reject)

Team — consolidating for an explicit sign-off. Nimbus needs a yes/no to hit their procurement window. Summary: 

- Customer: Nimbus Cloud (Public pilot)
- Ask: Accept 99.5% uptime for first 12 months + service credit schedule (customer proposed higher credits) + one-time commercial concession
- Redwood proposed (per Vivek): 99.5% pilot uptime; credit schedule 5% / 10% / 20% by bucket; 18% year-one committed discount; credit claim-based; cap on monthly credits
- Legal redlines (Laura): make credits exclusive remedy, require claim submission + audit rights, reduce monthly credit cap to 15% OR require 24-month term; add reliability review at month 6 if term is 12 months
- Risk trade-off: short-term revenue push vs. exposure to larger credits if the service has a regression early on.

Decision requested: please respond with one of the below by EOD today so we can respond to Nimbus: 
A) APPROVE with the following binding terms: uptime 99.5% (12 months), credits as legal redline (exclusive remedy), monthly credit cap 15%, committed-year discount 18%, add 6-month reliability review
B) REJECT and propose to hold firm on standard SLA (99.95%)

Please reply inline with APPROVE or REJECT and any minor edits. Monica, flag any commercial constraints you see.

Grace
(Grace O'Connor)
Enterprise Sales Director

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive approval requested — Nimbus exceptions summary (Approve / Reject)

APPROVE, with the following minor edits: 
- Monthly credit cap: 15% (agree with Laura)
- Commercial concession: approve 18% committed-use discount for year one, but cap any future carve-outs to exec-only approvals
- Add: include a one-time uplift credit (non-refundable) of $10k to cover any onboarding reliability work if Nimbus misses the month-6 reliability targets

Laura — confirm you can insert the exclusive remedy language and the 15% cap into the amendment and we will route for signatures. Monica — please lock the SKU/pricing in HubSpot and prepare the PO template.

-Vivek

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lim <sara@nimbuscloud.com>, procurement@nimbuscloud.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: SLA uplift trade & remedy flexibility for enterprise pilot — Approved terms

Sara / Team — thanks for the patience. We appreciate the clarity on your needs and have an approved path to get you live this quarter. Please find the agreed terms below: 

1) Uptime: 99.50% for the first 12 months of the pilot.
2) Service credits (claim-based, exclusive remedy):
   - 98.00–99.49% monthly uptime: 5% credit
   - 96.00–97.99% monthly uptime: 10% credit
   - <96.00% monthly uptime: 20% credit
   - Monthly credits capped at 15% of that month's recurring invoice
3) Commercial concession: 18% committed-use discount on year-one consumption; one-time $10,000 onboarding reliability credit if month-6 reliability targets are not met (non-refundable)
4) Term & controls: 12-month minimum pilot; dedicated reliability review at month 6; customer must submit credit claims within 30 days of the invoice month and grant audit access limited to telemetry verification for claims

Next steps: Monica will send the DocuSign amendment (with Laura's redlines) and a PO template for your procurement team to complete. Targeting signature by July 16 to meet your procurement timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Nimbus live.

Grace O'Connor
Enterprise Sales Director, Redwood Inference
